recipeDesc: Mid-cycle underwrite: normalized operating margin on a mid-cycle revenue base, valued at an exit EV/LTM-EBITDA multiple; reward/risk measured at SPOT.

assumptions.method: Legs set against reported history: bear holds a trough below FY2025 with continued One-Way shrink; base is a modest cyclical recovery above FY2025; bull sits just above the FY2022 peak on a genuine cycle turn.

references.label: FY2025 reported revenue
references.source: EDGAR companyfacts us-gaap Revenues, FY2025 (verified 2026-07-20 vs EDGAR companyfacts)

references.source: EDGAR companyfacts us-gaap Revenues, FY2022 (verified 2026-07-20 vs EDGAR companyfacts)

assumptions.method: Modeled off the 7.45% own-history median anchor: base deducts ~125bps for the structurally higher insurance run-rate and ~50bps for the Dedicated mix shift capping One-Way upside; bear is a slight lift off the ~0% FY2025 underlying floor; bull re-rates toward but below the FY2021 consolidated peak.

assumptions.method: Chosen against the own-history TEV/LTM-EBITDA band: bear between trough and median, base at roughly the median, bull toward the upper quartile on a genuine cycle turn.

facts.basis: ANALYST ASSUMPTION, not a filing figure — normalized cash-tax rate for the FCF cross-check only; does not touch value/share

scenarios.name: bear
scenarios.reason: trough persists; One-Way keeps shrinking; underlying FY25 ex the Q2 insurance credit was ~breakeven, so 1.5% is slight lift off a ~0% floor.

scenarios.name: base
scenarios.reason: deviates from 7.45% anchor: insurance run-rate +~125bps (2018-22 avg 4.06% -> 2025-26 underlying ~5.3%, ex one-off Q2-25 favorable credit); ~50bps for Dedicated mix shift 51.5%->73% capping One-Way upside in peak-margin years.

scenarios.name: bull
scenarios.reason: genuine cycle turn: One-Way rebounds on tight capacity + driver-supply tightening; Dedicated fully loaded. Below 12-14% 2020-22 peaks (One-Way exposure reduced; insurance ~125bps higher).

verdict.rationale: FAIL at 2:1 (ratio -0.35, reward -10.31 at spot 46.04). Base sits ~22% below spot; corroborated by EV/EBIT 16.1x at base and ~3.7% normalized FCF yield — priced to its own recovery. Quality franchise, not broken -> WATCH, not AVOID.
reunderwriteTriggers: a reported quarter proving normalized operating margin genuinely >7.5% (e.g. disclosed Dedicated segment economics, or a clean beat)
verdict.avoidPricedNote: inverted asymmetry at 46 (upside +6% to bull, downside -22% base / -64% bear) -> track for avoid-leg short-alpha on paper.
